subject: regression line on a quantile-quantile plot.

messages.author: ded8250ac83a88c7
messages.subject: regression line on a quantile-quantile plot.
parts:
Dear friends,

I am constructing a normal Quantile-quantile plot for a variable x by using stat_qq of ggplot2. This plot is constructed as plot 3 below.

To this plot, I want to add a regression line (with 95 % confidence ) with stat_smooth by using the output variables "..theoretical.. " and "..sample.." generated by stat_qq. It is not working. Can someone give me a suggestions how to solve this problem?


x <- rnorm(50)
x_df <- data.frame(x)
plot3 <- ggplot(x_df, aes(sample = x)) + stat_qq()
plot4 <- plot3 + stat_smooth(method = "lm", aes(y=..theoretical.., x= ..sample..),
formula = y~x)
plot4

Kind regards,

An

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: regression line on a quantile-quantile plot.
parts:
Dear An,

I'm not sure if this is possible in ggplot2. You are trying to use
aesthetics from stat_qq() in stat_smooth(). I think that the output
aesthetics from stat_qq() are only available within stat_qq(). Hence
stat_smooth() throws an error.

I tried to use geom = "smooth" in stat_qq() but that just connects every
point of stat_qq().

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(x_df, aes(sample = x)) + stat_qq() + stat_qq(geom = "smooth",
method = "lm")

The quick and dirty solution to your problem is to calculate
..theoretical.. And ..sample.. Outside ggplot and then plot them.

library(ggplot2)
x <- runif(100)
x_df <- data.frame(sample = x)
x_df$theoretical <- qqnorm(x_df$sample, plot.it = FALSE)$x
ggplot(x_df, aes(y = sample, x = theoretical)) + geom_smooth(method =
"lm") + geom_point()

Best regards,

Thierry
